recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any broader cleanup or reintroduction of current-list mechanics after the R6 lifecycle-page removal should be handled through an active current-list issue or work-group/API Incubator follow-up rather than this rejected DSTU2 clarification request.
issue_request: FHIR-11271 asked for more explanation of "current resource lists", including how to know whether a resource belongs to a current list and whether status or period values determine membership. The Published Jira disposition was Not Persuasive, explaining that current-list membership represents clinical curation and generally cannot be determined from the resource content alone.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11271 was found. The underlying current-list feature was introduced by the earlier FHIR-7551 implementation, while current source still preserves the curation principle in List notes and the lifecycle page has since had its detailed current-list section removed rather than expanded.
additional_context: FHIR-47135 later reaffirmed a No Change position that current does not mean status=active and reflects business rules. FHIR-47134 sought additional expected-status guidance but remains Resolved - change required and is outside this default Applied/Published source-edit scope. A 2024 Zulip thread similarly states that current-list determination is server-side business logic, and a 2025 R6 source commit removed the detailed lifecycle current-list text due to lack of implementation experience.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding the requested explanatory lifecycle text would conflict with the Not Persuasive seed disposition, while the current source avoids asserting that status, period, or any resource-local data alone determines current-list membership.
